name: iam:PassRole + apprunner:CreateService
description: A principal with iam:PassRole and apprunner:CreateService can create an AWS App Runner service with a privileged IAM role attached. The service's StartCommand executes as args to the aws CLI (ENTRYPOINT), running with the instance role's permissions. The container exits after the command; App Runner marks the service CREATE_FAILED, but the payload effect has already occurred.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must be in the Resource section
Must have permission to create App Runner services

additional.description: Needed on first App Runner use in an account to create the service-linked role
Helpful for discovering available roles to pass
Useful for viewing role trust policies
List App Runner services to verify service creation

admin: A role must exist that trusts tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com to assume it
The role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: A role must exist that trusts tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com to assume it

references.title: Getting Shell and Data Access in AWS App Runner
HackTricks Cloud - AWS App Runner Privilege Escalation

options.name: ROLE_ARN

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for App Runner service deployment

options.name: CONTAINER_IMAGE
options.description: Container image with aws-cli ENTRYPOINT (StartCommand becomes args)
